guidance_capabilities.note: Explicit engineering receive-fit declaration from this card's authored guidance. Enabled launcher updates execute through the native release-bound finite transport and accepted platform fusion; false does not assert hardware absence. A return transmitter is enabled only by a separately sourced exact variant/launcher profile. Numeric transport, navigation and feedback policies remain disclosed engineering assumptions, not calibrated equipment performance.

guidance: inertial midcourse with datalink updates, terminal infrared homing

span_m.note: No official span is published; 0.48 m is a secondary estimate

power_up_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

power_down_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

explosive_kg.note: a game reference: War Thunder's fr_mica_em (the MICA EM's) (PBXN-110); no manufacturer or encyclopedia gives the charge

gurney_kms.note: PBXN-110 (88 % HMX in a polymer binder) is not in Cooper's table: between Comp B (2.70) and LX-14 (2.80, 95 % HMX) less its larger binder share - an estimate

drag_area_m2.note: Engineering estimate A_D = CD_simulated*S_geometry at neutral Mach .3. Inputs, dated model-specific searches and method limits are in hangar-vlm.simulation and the evidence catalog. Assumed one-sigma screening uncertainty is |A_D| in m2; its coverage probability is not established. Equipment drag error remains unknown; the table evidence basis is simulated.

mbda-mica-identity.title: MICA
mbda-mica-identity.note: Manufacturer specification page; supplies mass, length and diameter only.

wt-datamine.title: War Thunder datamine: rocketguns weapon files (a game reference: the game's own values, not a manufacturer's)

hangar-vlm.title: Shared Hangar aircraft VLM tables
hangar-vlm.note: Same base, rate and Mach data as the released JSBSim model; no equipment calibration claim.

method_sources: Katz and Plotkin, Low-Speed Aerodynamics, vortex lattice
Shared aero/model.py, tables.py and mach.py; engineering extensions are not equipment measurements

limitations: Generic AGARD-B geometry, not any of the 88 authored equipment models.
The publication pools facilities/model sizes and includes M0.8/M1.2 runs with the M0.77/M1.17 groups; no common Reynolds condition is supplied.
Body-normal force is derived as CN=CLf*cos(alpha)+CDf*sin(alpha), cancelling axial base-pressure force; reported CZ=-CN.
The 4% biconvex wing uses the existing shared section; its tiny specified leading-edge radius is not separately resolved.
Density/Reynolds and sting/wall interference differences remain. Residuals are not an equipment confidence interval.
No beta, dynamic derivative, powered flow or extreme-angle qualification follows from these conditions.

uncertainty.method: Coupled vortex-lattice/body/section/rate solution, common Mach extensions and common JSBSim tables; retained overrides are listed separately.
uncertainty.table_domain: Actual Mach/alpha/beta bounds are read from the generated product in hangar-vlm.simulation; no narrowing of the authored envelope.
uncertainty.uncertainty_basis: assumed engineering screening range, not measured equipment error or a probabilistic confidence interval
uncertainty.uncertainty_formula: Inside the generic comparison conditions: max(1,2*generic_NRMSE/100); outside them no finite equipment-error bound is established.
uncertainty.boundaries: Generic validation cannot identify equipment-specific separated flow, powered flow, Reynolds effects or extreme-angle errors; those remain unknown.
uncertainty.uncertainty_application: Assumed screening envelope only, not a measured model error or statistical bound. Applies to generic CZ/Cm comparison conditions; no finite equipment-error bound outside those conditions and no calibrated CD/CY/Cl/Cn uncertainty.
uncertainty.input_assumptions: Author-declared geometry and shared section/body correlations. Surface sections, sweep, twist, controls, body stations, mass/CG, analysis speed and all retained overrides are readable in aircraft/micair/micair.toml. Product extrema are generation coverage, not a validated physical domain.

native-vector-engineering.title: Finite equivalent thrust-vector actuator and native nozzle transform
native-vector-engineering.note: Reference for native force-frame rotation and moment arm only. Vector angle/rate are uncalibrated engineering inputs, not measured vane or nozzle data. Native virtual-channel lag is retained once.

mbda-mica-dual-waveband.title: MICA - dual waveband imaging Infrared seeker
mbda-mica-dual-waveband.note: Manufacturer identifies IR MICA as dual-waveband imaging infrared. It does not publish exact band edges, focal-plane specifications or countermeasure algorithms; numeric detector and association inputs linked here are explicit engineering assumptions, not manufacturer values.

seeker.note: MBDA documents a dual-waveband imaging infrared seeker. Two independently radiometric, noisy detector channels execute measured angular pairing and spectral-continuity association; no truth identity or source class enters discrimination. Exact bands, detector constants and spectral gates are explicit uncertain engineering assumptions.
seeker.validity: Dual-waveband physical execution; selected engineering passbands are not manufacturer-published hardware specifications or calibrated countermeasure performance.

guidance.note: PN from admitted measurement history. Existing navigation gain, acceleration limit, lifetime and capability declarations are unchanged. Permitted launch estimates remain separate inertial-midcourse inputs. Where an authored receive fit is admitted, WorldWeaponLinks delivers accepted platform fusion through finite modeled transport before guidance can consume an update; unsupported fitted paths remain unavailable. Return telemetry requires its separately admitted equipment and launcher integration.
guidance.validity: Uncalibrated engineering guidance. No hidden target range or velocity in terminal bearing guidance; no claim of GPS, fitted weapon link, hardware covariance, full-envelope or equipment performance.

autopilot.note: Signed finite aerodynamic-fin plus equivalent thrust-vector control using current-CG moments, native thrust and same-frame force/moment feedback. All physical forces and moments are integrated by JSBSim.
autopilot.validity: Uncalibrated combined-effectiveness engineering controller. Fin and nozzle actuators have finite stops/rates, with the existing virtual-channel lag applied once; no measured jet-vane or nozzle hardware response or high-off-boresight envelope is established.

simulation_model.calibration: MICA IR is uncalibrated. MICA IR executes two separately rendered thermal bands with its own retained-state/association rules; its 112 kg body and motor match the EM design only at the declared structural inputs. Dual-band receiver state and spectral errors cannot be calibrated by an EM RF run. Retained card anchors: mass 112.0 kg (published; source mbda-mica-identity; uncertainty 1.0), length 3.1 m (published; source mbda-mica-identity; uncertainty 0.02), diameter 0.16 m (published; source mbda-mica-identity; uncertainty 0.001), warhead 12.0 kg (published; source wp-mica; uncertainty 1.0), explosive 3.7 kg (published; source wt-datamine; uncertainty 0.56). Current receiver thermal_dual_image.v1; control fsim.control.load_feedback_cascade; propulsion fsim.propulsion.jsbsim_generated_solid_rocket; fuze native.fuze.swept_path.v1; warhead native.warhead.authored_field.v3. Band-specific optics/QE/integration and target spectra are engineering records; manufacturer identity and bulk mass do not establish exact dual-band discrimination or native flight/effects accuracy. Source classes and uncertainty records remain unchanged; assumed, derived and game-reference values are not promoted to equipment measurements. Per-model theory, parameter deltas and numerical method routes are in docs/research/sim-m03/component-methods/per-model-effects-components.json and per-model-six-components.json; the separate docs/research/sim-m03/calibration-ledger.json identifies the remaining equipment comparisons. Arithmetic or native scenario verification does not establish held-out accuracy. No admitted same-model independent baseline-to-new held-out calibration receipt is claimed; engineering completion continues through its own gates.
